{{Youmay|the term referring to individuals from the [[Rim]]|"[[Fringer/Legends|fringer]]," a term referring to individuals from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] frontier regions|linebreak=1}}
{{Quote|Rimmer punk, huh? Chentu Chek and I will have to have a little talk about that.|[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
'''Rimmer''' was a phrase used to refer to someone who hailed from the [[Rim]], the most rimward regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], namely the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The term of Rim was commonly used in opposition to the [[Greater Core|Core]] that included the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The distinction between the Core and the Rim originated the most ancient times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when the Republic space encompassed an area similar to the Greater Core while the rest of the galaxy was already known as the Rim.<ref name="TEA" /> Hence, inhabitants of the Core often considered themselves superior and more civilized than the Rimmers.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="DF:SftE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], few Rimmers had an opportunity of good education such as in the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. [[Cadet/Legends|Cadet]] [[Nathan Donar III]] used to call [[Kyle Katarn]] "Rimmer" as a nickname, which annoyed him.<ref name="DF:SftE" />

The term was used in the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Rimmer's Alley]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]],<ref name="DF:RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> and the [[Music/Legends|song]] [[Rimmer's Delight]].<ref name="DF:SftE" />
